author: vW4n
content: Leaf imports migrated. did_doc parsers -> proto_blue::common::did_doc. HandleResolver -> proto_blue::identity (timeout_ms ctor, resolve returns Option<String>). Server-side DidDocument for /.well-known/did.json moved to crate::identity::did_document. PasswordHasher -> crate::auth. blob helpers -> crate::blob_store::mime. oauth_admin.rs rewritten against proto-blue OAuthClient (OAuthClientMetadata, authorize/callback_with_iss for RFC 9207).
